LESSON: WRITING 2.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PUNCTUATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.5: Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to use punctuation marks correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the double quotation marks and the bracket in a text
2. use the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts
3. appreciate the role of the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 2.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PUNCTUATION
This lesson teaches Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the double quotation marks and the bracket in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation above.
2. Explain Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to use punctuation marks correctly?
2. How do we use the double quotation marks and the bracket in writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the double quotation marks and the bracket in a text
2. use the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts
3. appreciate the role of the double quotation marks and the bracket in written texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
